about: Concept codebook for the AI-music niche, written from the 2026-10-25 run's pack (verified + wider outliers). A concept is the topic shape outliers share, not their words. Matched on title + description; counted by `viral_research.py concepts --niche ai-music`. Precision checked by reading every match; loose rules tightened once (2026-10-25).

concepts.name: genre-swap cover of a famous song
concepts.note: a known song re-made in an unexpected genre (Heavy Metal, flamenco rumba, soul, R&B, doo-wop, ska...)

concepts.name: era swap (retro decade)
concepts.note: a song or sound placed in another decade: 1950s soul, 80s heavy metal, 40s-50s vintage, euro disco

concepts.name: in the style of an artist
concepts.note: a new song sold through a famous artist's style or a crossover pair (al estilo de, inspired, x, type track, artist + IA)
concepts.match: al estilo de|estilo de|inspired|type (track|beat)| (ozuna|romeo santos|wisin|bad bunny|karol ?g|sean paul|dua lipa|drake|weeknd|daddy yankee|luis miguel) [^|]{0,30} (ia|ai) | (ia|ai) [^|]{0,10} (ozuna|romeo santos|bad bunny|luis miguel)
seeds: canción con ia de bad bunny

concepts.name: legend what-if / dream duet
concepts.note: music that never existed: a dead or separated legend singing another's song, two legends together, a 'demo' that never was
concepts.match: what if|qu[eé] pasar[ií]a|\bdemo\b|dream duet|whitney|celine|lionel richie|michael jackson|beatles|elvis|freddie|juan gabriel|selena|camilo sesto|rocío d[uú]rcal

concepts.name: epic / fantasy world music
concepts.note: an original song inside a world: Viking, Nordic, Celtic, Egyptian, tribal, swamp outlaw, enchanted forest, cinematic

concepts.name: grief and lost-love ballad
concepts.note: an emotional story song about loss, absence or love that cools (often 'live performance' or piano ballad)
concepts.match: lost you|lose you|missing you|miss you|te vas|te fuiste|adi[oó]s|extra[ñn]o|perd[ií]|amor que se|llorar|heartbreak|broken heart|💔|ballad|balada|never stopped|nunca dej

concepts.name: long mix / playlist
concepts.note: a 20 min to 3 h mix of AI songs in one style (bachata mix, euro disco mix, best songs inspired by Cuba)

concepts.name: how I made it / tutorial
concepts.note: the making of an AI song or video: tutorial, step by step, 'I made X in Suno', free tools
concepts.match: how to|how i|i made|made a|i tried|i tested|tutorial|step by step|full guide|c[oó]mo (hacer|crear|hago)|paso a paso|hice|compuse|gu[ií]a|gratis

concepts.name: AI-music debate, news and reactions
concepts.note: the story around AI music: monetisation truth, musicians panicking, terrible AI music, real singer vs AI, fooled by AI
concepts.match: monetiz|panick|truth|verdad|nadie te dice|terrible|reddit|crackdown|blocks|bloque|debate|falling for|reaction|reacci[oó]n|super[oó] a la ia|vs\.? ?(la )?(ia|ai)|ai vs|ia vs|fake|losers

concepts.name: personal name / dedication song
concepts.note: a song made for one person: their name, birthday, anniversary, a family member

concepts.name: language swap of a famous song
concepts.note: a famous song sung in another language (English hit in Spanish, Enya in Spanish, a song in Nahuatl or Na'vi)

concepts.name: faith and worship
concepts.note: hymns, worship and Christian songs made with AI

concepts.name: humour and challenge
concepts.note: funny or challenge songs: arguing with the AI, a song about the mother-in-law, impossible challenges, memes

concepts.name: surreal / visual-poem AI music video
concepts.note: the visuals carry it: a recognisable surreal or painterly AI art style, often a recurring character
